prompt_records.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this approved pirate-cabin RESPONSE UI mockup. Make ONE layout correction: THE PORTRAIT AND THE PARCHMENT DIALOGUE BOX MUST HAVE EXACTLY THE SAME OUTER HEIGHT AND ALIGNED TOP AND BOTTOM EDGES. The portrait is square, at the left. Its top wooden frame edge sits at exactly the same horizontal level as the dialogue box's top wooden frame edge; their bottom edges also line up. Make the red "Your response" ribbon fit INSIDE the box's top band rather than sticking above that common top edge. Use a narrow consistent gap, no merging two frames.
Target layout at 1920x1080: portrait outer box x80 y720 width300 height300. Dialogue box x394 y720 width1446 height300. Both stop at y1020. Scale the coordinates proportionally if needed. Keep the portrait's whole face, mouth and chin inside its square with no distortion. Keep all three state features in the dialogue: several response rows, a two-line wrapped response, a distinct red selected row and right vertical scroll bar. Additional responses below can be clipped/faded by the scrolling viewport; never make one box taller for content.
Preserve the approved walnut/parchment/brass art and exact room palette, design and composition. Keep Count Fingers' bowl at its current location; the aligned portrait may naturally cover the lower part of his bowl. Do not move or resize the bowl or character to dodge the UI. Keep everything else unchanged, no new modern fittings. The carpet is still a scene concept and does not need added detail.
Retain the visible response text from the reference where it fits: "Your response"; "1. About this captive of yours."; "2. What is in the pot?"; "3. Ask about the recipe."; "4. Has Count Fingers been fed, or is he still planning to eat the crew?"; "5. Carry on." (last row may be clipped). One full-screen 16:9 concept, no guide lines, no measurements, no callouts.

Use case: background-extraction / UI production asset. The reference image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for the approved parchment dialogue box. Create ONLY its clean empty DIALOGUE FRAME as a standalone, isolated 2D game UI asset on a genuinely TRANSPARENT canvas. No room, no people, no fish, no portrait frame.
Wide horizontal rectangle centered, image aspect about 3:1, object uses almost the full width with a narrow transparent safety gutter. A chunky worn walnut outer surround, restrained rounded brass corner guards with rivets at the FOUR corners, light warm ivory parchment filling the entire inner rectangular field. The parchment must be OPAQUE; only the background outside the frame is transparent. Orthographic perfectly front-facing, straight parallel top/bottom and left/right edges, no perspective tilt. Match the approved reddish walnut, warm ochre brass and softly worn pale parchment.
PRODUCTION 9-SLICE REQUIREMENTS: put all scrollwork and distinct brass fittings ONLY in fixed-size corners. The long top and bottom rails and short side rails are simple straight continuous wood with no special centered motifs, no nonuniform twists; the broad center is quiet pale parchment with extremely subtle paper grain. This asset will be stretched horizontally in Godot. Keep widths of rails consistent, about 6% of object height. Rounded corner ornaments occupy about 18% of object height. Clear generous rectangular reading area, decorative parts never protrude deeply into it. Minimal small shadow contained within the narrow outer transparent margin.
ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT OR NUMBERS, no speaker name/ribbon, no buttons, no arrows, no scrollbar, no circular option numbers, no highlight row, no portrait and no face. Those are separate live/overlay elements. One single EMPTY wide panel only. Preserve actual alpha around the entire outer silhouette, no fake checkerboard or solid background. Output a clean raster game asset, not a screenshot or multiple versions.

Use case: background-extraction / UI production asset. The reference image supplies the approved dark walnut/brass portrait-surround style. Create ONLY a separate SQUARE PORTRAIT FRAME, front-on, isolated on genuinely transparent background. It will display at 300 by 300 pixels and MUST BE SQUARE with equal width and height. The frame is a chunky worn carved warm-walnut surround with small restrained brass corner guards/rivets, rounded corners, subtly uneven hand-carved edge, matching the approved dialogue frame. It must feel like a pirate captain's carved picture frame. No extra hanging elements or crest. The border is compact, about 8% of the overall width on each side, leaving a large unobstructed rounded-square inner aperture for a live face. Keep any inner-corner ornaments outside the main clear hole. ALL FOUR corners fit fully inside the square image with only a very narrow safety margin. Orthographic front-facing, no tilt, not a picture frame standing in perspective.
CRITICAL: BOTH THE OUTSIDE BACKGROUND AND THE ENTIRE INNER PORTRAIT APERTURE ARE FULLY TRANSPARENT ALPHA. This is an EMPTY FRAME WITH A REAL HOLE. No portrait, face, hat, person, room, red backing, glass, paper or opaque fill within the hole. A separate live animated 3D portrait will appear there. No text, labels, letters or numbers. No fake checkerboard painted into the hole. One single square frame only, no dialogue panel. Match the reference wood-and-brass finish precisely.

Use case: background-extraction. Create a single EMPTY RED SPEAKER-NAME RIBBON as a reusable game UI bitmap matching the supplied Captain's Ledger reference. This is just the deep oxblood red cloth label that says "Your response" in the reference, with ALL TEXT REMOVED. Only the label, no wood frame, no portrait, no scene, no other components. A wide horizontal dark red fabric ribbon, softly folded leather-like worn cloth with very restrained hand-painted creases and small notched/folded ends; shaded dark red edges and a calm broad opaque red center where a live name will be drawn. Tiny restrained antique-brass attachment detail at left is okay but no large circle or crest. Front-facing 2D HUD art, perfectly horizontal, straight upper/lower center edges. At runtime it fits a 350x40px label area INSIDE a dialogue frame, so keep it low, long, uncluttered, with a generous flat central stretch area, fixed folded ends. No characters, letters, numbers, logos, glyphs, parchment, arrows or buttons. Genuinely transparent outside the ribbon, preserve alpha. One wide ribbon centered on transparent landscape canvas, nearly full width. Same worn warm cartoon materials as reference, not realistic satin. Absolutely blank.

Use case: background-extraction. Create a single EMPTY SELECTED-RESPONSE HIGHLIGHT BAR as a reusable game UI bitmap. Match the selected red second response in the supplied Captain's Ledger reference. One slim wide horizontal rounded rectangle, deep warm oxblood-red opaque center with subtle flat leather/cloth grain, a slender continuous antique-gold/brass outline around all four sides, dark brown outer bevel, gently rounded corners. The center is plain and empty, with no symbols or text. It will stretch to widths of over 1000px and heights of 44 to 80px: put distinctive detail only at its tiny corners; make top/bottom edges straight, continuous and simple. It is a selection treatment inside parchment, not another thick panel, no carved wood surround, no scrollwork, no medallion, no number, no arrow. Extremely important: NO letters, words, glyphs or characters anywhere. No scene. Genuinely transparent outside the silhouette; the inner red band is opaque. One isolated horizontal bar near full canvas width, small transparent margin, aspect about 3:1 canvas with the actual long slim bar centered. Worn but crisp stylized 2D pirate-game UI art, matching the reference.

Use case: UI game sprite atlas. Create ONE production SPRITE ATLAS PNG on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background, matching the warm cartoon antique-brass and dark-walnut controls from the supplied Captain's Ledger reference. Six separate isolated sprites arranged in a precise THREE-COLUMN by TWO-ROW grid on a 3:2 landscape canvas. Equal grid cells, all sprites centered in their own cell, large clear transparent bands between cells. No touching, no crossing cell borders, no labels, no numbers, no text, no room or parchment.

TOP ROW, LEFT TO RIGHT:
1. Simple upward-pointing triangular brass SCROLL UP ARROW icon, chunky bevel, no round button behind it, no shaft, clear silhouette.
2. Matching downward-pointing triangular brass SCROLL DOWN ARROW icon, exactly the same style and scale, no button behind, no shaft.
3. Simple right-pointing brass CHEVRON icon, one 'greater than' shape with chunky bevel and a thin dark brown edge, no button behind. This is the continue/selection cursor.

BOTTOM ROW, LEFT TO RIGHT:
4. A short vertical brass SCROLL THUMB, a narrow rounded rectangle/pill with a warm gold face, slight bright bevel and darker edge. Approx proportions width:height 1:2.6, no text or engraved marks.
5. A long narrow VERTICAL SCROLL TRACK only, a dark walnut-brown recessed straight channel with softly rounded ends and thin darker outline, proportions width:height 1:7. IMPORTANT no thumb and no arrows attached to this track; those are the separate sprites. Make its middle straight and uniform so it can stretch vertically.
6. One EMPTY circular CHOICE NUMBER MEDALLION: muted dark red-brown opaque center, simple concentric brass bevelled rim, no number, no letter or emblem. It will have a live number drawn over it in the game.

Use the reference's clean worn hand-painted warm brass rather than shiny photorealism. Each sprite fully inside its cell with transparent padding. Real alpha, no fake checkerboard. No drop shadows connecting pieces, no added ornaments, exactly these six components, one atlas.
